title: Anthropic Company Rollout - Claude Code CEO Coaching - Ongoing AI Mentoring
description:
About the Project:

We are a global, fully remote e-commerce company. We are looking for an experienced freelance AI Consultant to lead our company-wide Anthropic Claude integration and act as a long-term sparring partner for our CEO. This is a strategic, hands-on project planned for the next 12 to 24 months.

Key Responsibilities:

- Company-Wide Rollout: Lead the global implementation of Anthropic Claude across our teams.
- AI Architecture: Design and develop a scalable company architecture for AI integration.
- Corporate LLM / Knowledge Base: Digitalize our entire company know-how and build an internal, AI-searchable knowledge base.
- CEO Coaching: Conduct weekly 1-on-1 sessions to coach the CEO (non-technical background) on using "Claude Code" and working in the terminal.
- Ongoing Mentorship: Serve as a strategic AI sparring partner and mentor over the next 1-2 years.

Ideal Candidate Profile:

- Deep technical expertise with Anthropic Claude, LLMs, and enterprise AI architecture.
- Experience building corporate knowledge bases (RAG, vector databases).
- Strong teaching and mentoring skills. You must be patient and able to explain technical concepts to a non-techy CEO.
- Forward-thinking, highly organized, and able to work independently.
- Language: German-speaking candidates are highly preferred (fluency in English is also required).

Project Details:

- Duration: 12 - 24 months
- Work Model: Fully Remote
- Engagement: Weekly coaching + ongoing project-based consulting
